title: Reaper
summary: A special class nobody has documented yet. Damage · steals life.

blocks.text: It is one of the special classes : they cannot be picked freely, you have to earn them. In the class window it is described as: Damage · steals life . The game whispers: “A mere human, alone in a dungeon, untouchable.” Like every special class, its level cap is higher than the 100 of the normal classes.
blocks.html:
• It is one of the special classes: they cannot be picked freely, you have to earn them.
  • In the class window it is described as: Damage · steals life.
  • The game whispers: “A mere human, alone in a dungeon, untouchable.”
  • Like every special class, its level cap is higher than the 100 of the normal classes.

blocks.text: Solo, no-hit, clear multiple dungeons of your same rank or above as a human (2-5)
blocks.html: Solo, no-hit, clear multiple dungeons of your same rank or above as a human (2-5)

blocks.text: As a reaper you want to take advantage of the lifesteal, therefore glueing yourself to the enemies to keep a constant heal going is the common way of playing reaper.
blocks.html: As a reaper you want to take advantage of the lifesteal, therefore glueing yourself to the enemies to keep a constant heal going is the common way of playing reaper.

blocks.text: Once you are a high level reaper its reccomended to put enough points in perception to keep 75% critical and have enough agility to keep a 60% evasion, then put the rest of the points into strength.
blocks.html: Once you are a high level reaper its reccomended to put enough points in perception to keep 75% critical and have enough agility to keep a 60% evasion, then put the rest of the points into strength.

blocks.text: Some users have experimented using SP and EX rank staffs to avoid the class debuff and play as a reaper-mage.
